summary.text: Missy Irvin was first elected to the Arkansas Senate in 2010 and represents District 24, which includes Searcy, Stone and Van Buren counties and parts of Cleburne, Faulkner and Newton counties.

paragraphs.text: She chairs the Senate Public Health, Welfare and Labor Committee.

Raised in Little Rock, she earned a B.A. from Randolph-Macon Women's College, is Marketing Director of Irvin-Dibrell Clinic in Mountain View, and has lived in Mountain View with her husband, Dr. John Dawson Irvin, for more than 22 years.

sources.title: Biography of The Honorable Missy Thomas Irvin, Arkansas State Senator
